eval_name: Script worktree cleanup with NUL-safe listing, no filesystem deletion
prompt:
Write a bash snippet that finds the linked task checkouts under
/repo/.worktrees, removes each one whose directory still exists on disk,
and then prunes stale registrations. Task names may contain spaces.
Give me the exact script plus the checks around it, in order.
No repository is attached here, so do not search the filesystem: answer
with the script and its checks only.
